title: 183 Million Shoppers This Weekend. Budget First
description: The National Retail Federation expects about 183 million Americans to shop over Thanksgiving weekend 2026: about 126 million on Black Friday and 66.1 million on Cyber Monday, with 48% saying deals are the main reason they shop. Educational only, not financial advice. #blackfriday #personalfinance #shorts

title: He Failed Twice. Then Hershey Sold for $1 Million
description: Milton Hershey's Philadelphia candy shop, opened in 1876, failed, and so did his New York venture. Back in Lancaster, his fresh-milk caramels took off, and in 1900 he sold the Lancaster Caramel Company for $1 million before focusing on chocolate. #miltonhershey #entrepreneur #shorts
